tasks.title: Определитель целочисленной матрицы
tasks.prompt:
Compute the determinant of the following 6×6 integer matrix A.

[  2  -1  -1   2   2   2 ]
[ -3  -4   3   4   2   0 ]

[ -1   4   4   3   2   0 ]

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
